summary.text: Carole Fiola is a Democratic state representative who has represented the Massachusetts House of Representatives 6th Bristol District since September 25, 2013 and is seeking re-election in the November 3, 2026 general election.

paragraphs.text: Carole Fiola assumed office in the 6th Bristol District on September 25, 2013.
Ballotpedia's campaign finance history for her also lists wins in 2002, 2004, 2006 and 2008 for Executive Councilor District 1.
For 2025-2026 she was assigned to the House Rules Committee, the Rules Joint Committee, and the Economic Development and Emerging Technologies Joint Committee, which she chairs.
